the combined effects of the genetic polymorphs of the RNA polymerase core promoter and the PBREM on UGT1 transcription mediated by CAR and PXR, which are the first to be reported.

the combined genotypes of A(TA)n and –3279T > G have combined effects on the transcription mediated by CAR and PXR, and the combined genotype of A(TA7) and –3279 G has a greater effect than A(TA6) plus –3279 T.
